_comment: Move definitions. 'type' may be "none" only for status moves. Categories: physical (attack vs defense), spirit (spirit vs spirit), status (no damage). Validated by tools/validate_data.py.

moves.name: Thorn Lash
moves.description: A whip of barbed runner, drawn quick across the flank.

moves.name: Seedburst
moves.description: Pods split all at once, and the air turns to chaff and noise.

moves.name: Shale Strike
moves.description: A plate of flat rock brought down on an angle.

moves.name: Weight of Years
moves.description: Something very old leans on the mind, and the mind sags.

moves.name: Updraft
moves.description: A column of warm air, shoved upward hard enough to lift.

moves.name: Keening
moves.description: A thin note held far past where a throat should manage.

moves.name: Silt Drag
moves.description: The ground goes soft underfoot and does not give the foot back.

moves.name: Miasma
moves.description: Marsh gas off standing water, sweet and wrong.

moves.name: Ember Bite
moves.description: Contact just long enough to leave a mark shaped like teeth.

moves.name: Kindle
moves.description: Heat gathered somewhere behind the eyes and then let go.

moves.name: Witherpalm
moves.description: A touch that takes a little of whatever it lands on.

moves.name: Long Dusk
moves.description: Evening arrives early and stays, in a radius, for a while.

moves.name: Gore
moves.description: Head down, weight behind it, no particular art to it.

moves.name: Howl
moves.description: Not a warning. An appetite, announced.

moves.name: Bristle
moves.description: Everything that can be raised is raised.

moves.name: Quicken
moves.description: A shudder that runs the length of the body and settles.
